closest_prior_work_summary: Ye 2014 (PMID 24462238): NHANES III second exam, PCE, real remeasurement of SBP only (~17 days); 12/106 with 5%-<10% risk crossed 7.5%.
Ogunwale 2016 (PMID 26869459): ARIC, PCE, same-day 2nd vs 3rd sitting SBP; 5.8% reclassified.
Ulbricht 2018 (PMID 29728071): SCORE, real remeasurement of TC and SBP ~24 days apart but different BP protocols; marginal category shifts only.
Cole 2023 (PMID 37624942): simulated lipid BV, PCE-based groups; 6.3% misclassified.

Data-source precedents without risk rescoring: Coresh 2002 (creatinine at two NHANES III visits, n=1,919, median 17 days), Selvin 2013 (kidney measures incl. ACR ~18 days apart), Lacher 2005 (biological variation of NHANES III analytes).
novelty_search.assessment: Nothing found weakens the claim as worded (PREVENT; real short-interval remeasurement; all routinely measured inputs). The claim would be weakened if worded more broadly (e.g., 'first to rescore a CVD risk equation after real remeasurement' - Ye 2014 did this for the PCE with SBP in the same NHANES III data; Ulbricht 2018 did it for SCORE with TC and SBP). Recommend phrasing 'to our knowledge' and explicitly contrasting with Ye 2014 (single input, PCE) and Ulbricht 2018 (two inputs, SCORE, protocol change). Limitations of the search: PubMed and web only (no Embase/Scopus/medRxiv full-text search); Consensus results capped at 3.
